capabilities: Convert wiki-link embeds to Markdown images
Convert Markdown images back to wiki-link embeds
Back up, roll back, and prune timestamped backups
Scope runs to the current note, current folder, a set folder, or the vault
disambiguation: Not a link-path resolver or attachment manager; it rewrites embed syntax only and never changes a link target.
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and explains limits extensively, including syntax it refuses to touch and size-parameter handling options.
motivation: The author wants a reversible conversion: rewriting paths would make mistakes permanent and the conversion irreversible, so the design keeps every path byte-for-byte unchanged.
problem: Obsidian's wiki-link embed syntax is non-standard, so notes stop rendering correctly in other Markdown tools, and manually converting hundreds of embeds is error-prone and hard to undo.
summary: Batch converter that rewrites Obsidian wiki-link embeds to Markdown image syntax and back, scoped to a note, folder, or whole vault.
